Happy Sunday good degens! Lots of stuff going on!
Let’s dive in!
As always… stats/alerts/etc at top and tweets/news/links/videos/etc at bottom… and all tweets are hyperlinked so just click on them to pull them up on Twitter/X!

Spotlight
Take note friends!
The legendary crew at @Mantle_Official [ https://substack.com/redirect/9509c092-6869-4b77-81fb-e7c241ca6668?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] continue to stack massive W’s in the world of RWA’s!
As broken down by our good friend @0xCheeezzyyyy recently [ https://substack.com/redirect/ed31db3a-fab7-4fd7-8764-cec83b500df4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], here is what it looks like:
“-1.4k tokenised assets available 
-$202M in distributed RWA value (according to @defillama)
-Stablecoin circulating supply maintaining its broader uptrend at ~$572M
-Native support for $USDG, Paxos’ stablecoin regulated in Singapore by MAS & compliant under MiCA in Europe 
On the RWA-Fi frontier, the distribution + structural developments are arguably even more notable.
1. Major distribution rails through @xStocksFi, @Securitize & @Ondo 
2. @OpenstockInc extending the asset universe into pre-IPO exposure through vaults
3. @Fluxion_network building out robust 24/7/365 secondary-market trading
4. Mantle’s Bybit vault reaching its first $100M within just a month of launch (according to @defillama)…”
In the above vein, Mantle had a massively successful RWA Day at Token2049 in Singapore, and you can read all about it here [ https://substack.com/redirect/171f1396-72fe-4a76-be47-be7a6e0062c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]!
In addition, Mantle’s Joshua Cheong [ https://substack.com/redirect/ac638b4e-572d-44ac-999e-50deef242711?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] appeared on a great panel with a number of other industry leaders that is well worth watching, and you can check out a brief clip via the below tweet or watch the panel in full by clicking here [ https://substack.com/redirect/4221ba9c-b82c-438e-9f72-4757599d6456?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]!
And- as always- make sure to follow @Mantle_Official [ https://substack.com/redirect/9509c092-6869-4b77-81fb-e7c241ca6668?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] on Twitter/X for more updates!
